scope: Spawn/parent-progress ETA ablation on new real-tool fixtures, fixed EWMA and margin

method.training: 3 complete calibration tasks per backend/state/case; progress phase uses same labels; subsequent predictions use past own-mode labels and only current observed spawn-return event
method.progression: epoch-bound parent event; ETA=actual spawn return + prior EWMA after-spawn duration; absolute dispatch=max(spawn return, ETA-prior preparation-5ms)
method.controls: Same shell/cwd/env/stdio/process-group/command and corrected file; no extra side effects, no command rerun on spawn error
method.costs: Save/evict/real tools/repair/final suffix included; initial history/load/calibration/oracle excluded and recorded
method.order: Modes rotate by replicate, independent states/initial seed per mode; no evaluation tuning or best-run selection

limits: One M5/Metal/model, warm OS cache; macOS26+ spawn validated only, older macOS/Linux keep fork and Windows/CUDA pending
Scripted actions isolate real tool execution/scheduling, not autonomous0.6B repair capability
PREFIX_READY early hold is not full KV occupancy integral or physical memory release
Progress reduces one timing uncertainty but does not guarantee simultaneous wait/hold improvement; negative pairs retained

sanitizers.scope: Current progress/spawn, Native/14K/KV/Stream and process-group/cancellation acceptance

cli_integration.scope: Native CLI registration/store/worker/tool path with deterministic Native-parser actions
